purpose: Validate the CLI session question deferral graph used by the desktop supervisor.

artifacts.retention_policy: Retained as the workspace human decision inbox until decisions are answered or archived.

resource_controls.timeout_policy: Each session keeps the existing SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS timeout.
resource_controls.cancellation_policy: The platform can cancel each active session and kill/wait the child process.
resource_controls.cleanup_policy: Session stdin is dropped on finish; stdout/stderr reader handles are joined when finished.
resource_controls.orphan_process_policy: Cancel calls kill and wait the child process; future PTY/process-group cleanup remains a follow-up.
resource_controls.backpressure_policy: stdout/stderr are read on separate threads into bounded buffers.

merge_strategy: A CLI question becomes a deferred decision; only the affected lane waits for answer/resume while independent work can continue.
plan_evidence: The user explicitly requested question deferral features.
The existing desktop backend already controls child stdin/stdout/stderr pipes.
The existing decision inbox and answer/resume command can store and resume affected lanes.
rollback_plan: Disable the Auto-defer questions toggle by default.
Keep manual defer and answer/resume available while adapter-specific detection fixtures are improved.
notes: Real CLI behavior still depends on user-installed optional adapters.
